components.html:
### Spell Description
You point dramatically at a creature and unleash a dazzling rainbow explosion. Glitter fills the air, fabulous music plays from nowhere, and your target becomes overwhelmed by magical flamboyance.
### Spell Effects
The target must make a Wisdom Saving Throw (DC 13).
On a Failed Save:
  • Fabulous Transformation: The target's clothing transforms into an outrageously fabulous outfit.
  • Sashay Away: The target must spend its next turn dramatically strutting 15 feet in a direction of your choice.
  • Distracting Aura: Enemies within 10 feet of the target suffer −2 to attack rolls because of the overwhelming fabulousness.
  • Slay: Once during the spell, the target shouts "SLAAAAY!" dealing 1d6 psychic damage to everyone within 5 feet. (to the Dm's Discretion)
On a Successful Save: The target resists the enchantment but is covered in glitter for 24 hours.
Each level Higher allows the caster to pick an additional Target
Special Ability: THE GAY AGENDA
If three creatures are affected by Gay simultaneously, they automatically form a synchronized dance troupe. All enemies who witness their performance must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or lose their next action applauding.
(Targets may decided they like this and wish to stay this way. Since its a choice to be gay)
